role_summary: Lead the company's technology strategy and operations, overseeing core card & loan systems, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance, while driving AI adoption for operational excellence and competitive advantage.
must_have_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
Minimum 10 years of IT leadership experience, ideally in financial services or consumer finance
Strong knowledge of full cycle IT services including infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies
Proven track record in managing large-scale IT projects and regulatory compliance
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese (Mandarin and Cantonese)
Authorized to work in Hong Kong SAR
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience in AI strategy and implementation
Prior working exposure in Japanese Company

scoring_criteria.name: IT Leadership Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Directly responsible for all IT functions; requires proven leadership at a senior level.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with fewer than 10 years may be considered if they show exceptional strategic impact.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services Domain Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core systems are card & loan systems; understanding of financial services is critical.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience in banking, consumer finance, or fintech
Knowledge of credit scoring, loan origination, card processing
Familiarity with regulatory environment in financial services
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from other industries must demonstrate transferable skills and learning agility.

scoring_criteria.name: Technical Expertise (Infrastructure, Applications, Cybersecurity)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Oversee all IT systems; breadth of technical knowledge ensures reliable operations.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Hands-on experience with infrastructure, networks, and applications
Knowledge of core banking systems or similar
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Deep expertise in one area may compensate for less in others.

scoring_criteria.name: AI & Automation Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Specifically responsible for AI adoption roadmap; critical for future competitiveness.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Preferred but not mandatory; candidates with strong potential may be considered.

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory & Compliance Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must manage IT governance, cybersecurity, data protection, PCIDSS frameworks.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience with compliance frameworks (PCIDSS, GDPR, etc.)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Familiarity with financial services regulations is key.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Vision & Digital Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Lead digital transformation and innovation initiatives; align IT with business growth.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Introduced new technologies to improve operations
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates should show examples of strategic impact.

scoring_criteria.name: Budget & Resource Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Manage IT budget and optimize resources for strategic priorities.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Relevant for senior roles; may be less critical if other strengths are present.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Excellent leadership and communication skills are essential for cross-functional collaboration.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Must be able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

scoring_criteria.name: Language Proficiency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Required command of English, Cantonese, and Mandarin for interaction with stakeholders.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Native or fluent in Cantonese and Mandarin
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Non-native speakers must demonstrate high proficiency.

scoring_criteria.name: Education & Qualifications
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Bachelor's degree in IT or related field is required; professional certifications add value.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with more experience may compensate for degree specifics.

summary_focus: Senior IT leader with 10+ years in financial services, specializing in core card/loan systems, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.
Proven track record in aligning IT strategy with business goals, driving AI adoption, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
Effective communicator fluent in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin, with strong stakeholder management skills.
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim AI implementation experience unless you have actual projects.
Do not exaggerate leadership years if less than 10.
Do not mention Japanese company experience if not applicable.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as a visionary IT leader who can modernize legacy systems and drive innovation, particularly in AI and digital transformation, while maintaining rigorous compliance.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If you lack AI experience, emphasize your ability to learn and your strategic understanding of AI opportunities.
If your background is not in consumer finance, highlight transferable skills from other regulated industries.
If you're not fluent in both Mandarin and Cantonese, state your level and commitment to improve.
